episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Officials find notices in Hanyang alleging the king is dead. Crown Prince Lee Chang tries to check on his father, but the young queen stands in his way.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Prince Chang and Moo Young arrive at Jiyulheon, where they make a horrific discovery. Seo Bi's story of what she saw eerily resonates with Prince Chang.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Night leads to chaos in Dongnae. Jo Hak Joo and the queen oversee the king's care. Prince Chang reaches a disquieting conclusion and vows to fight back.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: On his way to seek Lord Ahn Hyun's help, Prince Chang encounters a group of stranded survivors and leads them to Jiyulheon, following Seo Bi's advice.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Prince Chang's group comes across a village that oddly seems to be well-fed. While taking refuge at Lord Ahn Hyun's, Seo Bi notes something peculiar.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jo Hak Joo has chilling words for the queen, who's hiding a sinister secret. Prince Chang orders Sangju's defenses, but Seo Bi senses something awry.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: An unexpected setback in Sangju poses new problems for Prince Chang and the others. Seo Bi and Jo Bum Pal seek safety with Jo Hak Joo.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After Prince Chang breaks into Mungyeong Saejae, a nightmare unfolds. Officials search the queen's home, suspecting she is hiding something.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: When Jo Hak Joo is taken from his custody, Prince Chang goes after him. Seo Bi looks for a way to treat the disease. The queen awaits her prince.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Seo Bi shares a critical discovery with Prince Chang, who has a favor to ask of her. Jo Hak Joo visits the queen and demands she tell him the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: To save innocent lives, Prince Chang and his men take over Hanyang. The queen determines that if she can't have the throne, no one can.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: With the palace painted red with blood, Prince Chang is forced to pursue a risky strategy. Seo Bi takes the baby and hides.
